title: A generalized Gerver sofa for angled corridors
summary: The moving sofa problem asks for the maximal area of a two-dimensional object capable of being moved through a right-angled corridor of unit width. J. L. Gerver constructed a sofa of area $2.2195\dots$, which was only recently proven to be optimal by J. Baek. Here, I consider the moving sofa problem in an angled corridor, $C_{\varphi}$, of unit width for turn angles $0 < \varphi \le \frac{\pi}{2}$.
